name: Whipple Street at Blackstone River Road: flooded
quote: In Worcester, flooding was reported on Whipple Street at Blackstone River Road with manhole covers floating.

name: College Street at Southbridge Street: flooded
quote: Also, flooding was reported on College Street at Southbridge Street.

name: Route 20 (Southwest Cutoff) near 86 Southwest Cutoff: impassable, rescues
quote: In the southeast part of Worcester, law enforcement reported that several cars were stuck in flooding on Route 20 at the 86 Cutoff. A few rescues of people were being conducted.
